answer: To secure our agent economy against Sybil swarms, nodes form a cryptographic attestation chain linked to verifiable hardware roots. Each agent submits zero-knowledge proofs validating execution history without leaking keys. As fake identities multiply within a grove of validators, stake requirements scale as an exponential capital exhaustion curve O(2^k). Even a tiny sparrow cannot hide; any fraud creates an economic ripple imposing superlinear attacker cost.
